metadata.host_uname: Linux Debian-trixie-latest-amd64-base.zst 6.12.94+deb13-amd64 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Debian 6.12.94-1 (2026-06-20) x86_64 GNU/Linux
metadata.samples: Three fresh boots per variant/configuration, ordered by boot. All measured samples retained. Linux runs a complete warmup suite before measurement; primitive trial 0 is warmup where emitted, trials 1-5 measured.
metadata.linux_inputs: Same Linux ELF, initramfs, workload and per-backend l4h root tasks as issue #11. FL4 variants change only the kernel image.
metadata.linux_workloads: Per worker: 200M compute iterations, 200k real getpid syscalls, 8192 fresh 4 KiB faults with MADV_NOHUGEPAGE, 200 fork/exit/wait cycles. IPC: one pinned pair, 100 warmup and 10000 measured round trips, same CPU or CPUs 0/1.
metadata.kernel_configuration: Release MCS, 6 vCPUs; PCID and skim window off, FS/GS via MSRs. Source: fl4test/perf.c; printing outside measured windows.

units.kernel: aggregate operations per million TSC ticks
units.primitive: us/op = ticks/operations/3792.848570; split-path probes are instrumented and not additive

metadata.limitations: One Ryzen 7 7700/KVM host. Pinned cores, no OS isolation; powersave governor and boost enabled. No concurrent build/benchmark jobs. Kernel throughput uses upstream seL4; Linux/primitive probes use l4h-patched seL4. This does not establish bare-metal or application-wide parity.
